limitations: The explicit phase diagram is one-dimensional and symmetric, for centered Gaussian compound-Poisson perturbations of centered symmetric variance-gamma laws. The general perturbation identity is a direct consequence of the classical canonical-density criterion and is not claimed as a new general theorem. No stochastic-order or option-pricing claim is made. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older class-L and convolution-factor literature under different terminology.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Exact self-decomposability threshold for Gaussian compound-Poisson perturbations of symmetric variance-gamma laws
